context: M7 o3. Carmen's kitchen, Penn South. Rice, beans, the fan on high. She sees everything.

lines.speaker: char.carmen_arce
lines.text: Mijo, you look like a man who hasn't eaten since the Korean War. Sit.

lines.speaker: char.teddy_arce
lines.text: They're putting notices under doors, Ma. Thirty days. Old men, Ma.

lines.speaker: char.carmen_arce
lines.text: The union built this building. Nobody sells it while I live in it.

lines.speaker: char.carmen_arce
lines.text: Your hotel has no union. So who are you going to ask? Carl?

lines.speaker: char.teddy_arce
lines.text: Carl's offering work. Two hundred a week. Carrying.

lines.speaker: char.carmen_arce
lines.text: In nineteen seventy-one you also told me paper. Eat. You'll do what you do.
